limitations: Decorative door faces do not imply open interiors. Access stops outside the actual outer structural step or facade.
Models without authored door faces have unverified entrances; no entrances are invented.
Geometry and kit screening alone are not physical route acceptance. Pending gates remain explicit.
Explicit podiums extend the foundation support union with authored pedestrian landings; source structural footprints and open courtyards are retained.
